## What is optimization?
::: {.normal-font-face .incremental}
- Given an **objective function** $f(x): X \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$, find a solution $x \in X$ which minimizes or maximizes $f(x)$

  - $X$ can be single-dimensional or multidimensional
  
  - $X$ may be a subset of real numbers defined by a set of equations called **constraints**

- Another bullet point
:::
